g.title: G
g.text: Cardiovascular I: Hemodynamics, Atherosclerosis & Lipids — Concept Map (NURS 419, Lecture 10/15/2026)
CO = HR × SV · BP = CO × SVR · preload = STRETCH, afterload = PRESSURE · TC < 200 · LDL < 100 · HDL > 60 · TG < 150

g.title: flow
g.text: filling: AV valves open, semilunar closed

g.title: hr
g.text: SNS: NE → β₁ → ↑ HR, conduction, contractility
PNS: ACh → muscarinic → ↓ HR, AV conduction

g.title: co
g.text: drugs change HR, preload, afterload, contractility

g.title: sv
g.text: Frank–Starling: rubber band, up to a point

g.title: lipids
g.text: exercise = best way to raise HDL

g.title: prev
g.text: primary: prevent the first ASCVD event

g.title: other
g.text: fenofibrate: high TG · muscle risk + statin
